results.title: Juan Gabriel: Mi Primer Bellas Artes
results.original_title: Juan Gabriel: Mi Primer Bellas Artes
results.overview: Mexico’s most iconic concert comes to U.S. theaters on September 15th, celebrating Mexican Independence Day and commemorating the 10th anniversary of Juan Gabriel’s passing. Experience his legendary first performance at Mexico City’s “Palacio de Bellas Artes” in 1990—a landmark event that forever transformed Mexican music. More than three decades later, this historic concert returns in a special theatrical release with newly restored picture and sound, plus an exclusive new opening featuring never-before-seen rehearsal footage from Juan Gabriel’s personal archive that offers a unique glimpse into the making of this unforgettable night. Every song, every standing ovation, and every iconic moment has been revitalized, allowing longtime fans and new audiences to experience this extraordinary performance like never before. Celebrate the timeless legacy of Juan Gabriel on the big screen in this once-in-a-generation cinematic event.

results.title: Stardom 15th Anniversary Series ~ New Year Stars 2026 in Korakuen ~ Day 2
results.original_title: スターダム旗揚げ15周年記念シリーズ NEW YEAR STARS 2026 in KORAKUEN DAY2
results.overview: Stardom 15th Anniversary Series ~ New Year Stars 2026 in Korakuen ~ Day 2 was a professional wrestling event promoted by World Wonder Ring Stardom, held on January 11, 2026 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. It was main evented by Konami, Rina and Fukigen Death (members of H.A.T.E.) defending the Artist of Stardom Championship against Hina, Lady C and Tomoka Inaba (members of God's Eye).

results.title: Escort
results.overview: A police soldier is forced to become an escort for a female shooti to deliver the illegal cargo to its destination in order to obtain cancer medicine for his friend.

results.title: Marc by Sofia
results.overview: An intimate, unconventional portrait of Marc Jacobs, crafted by Sofia Coppola to capture the genius and singular universe of the iconic American designer.

results.title: A Story About Fire
results.overview: The legend of Ran Bi Wa talks about a monkey who was raised by humans. When he sets off to the Holy Mountain to steal fire for humankind, a journey begins from which he will return transformed into a man.

results.title: Love Yourself Tender
results.overview: Nadya is a successful otolaryngologist-surgeon, but by the age of 40 she suddenly realized that she didn't know anything about herself at all. Every day at work, she examines the sensory organs of patients, but she has forgotten how to hear her own feelings, or maybe she has never heard them. Her husband Boris left her two years ago, unable to stand the routine, although the couple is still not divorced. Nadya brings up her daughter Oliviya and continues to live in her mother-in-law's apartment. Nadya needs changes to see that there really is a lot of love in the world. And in her life there are six "lessons of tenderness", each of which will help her to find herself again, her own voice and her new hope.

results.title: What Remains: Die Toten Hosen – The Last Album
results.original_title: Was bleibt: Die Toten Hosen – Das letzte Album
results.overview: In "What Remains: Die Toten Hosen – The Last Album", director Eric Friedler exclusively follows the iconic rock band over the course of two years as they create their final studio album. Never before has the band allowed themselves to be observed so intimately in the studio. The film crew also goes behind the scenes of a European tour that the band scheduled in between their studio sessions. The result is a moving tribute to a band that has written German music history and continues to inspire generations to this day.

results.title: Liggetid
results.overview: Short film about the misadventures of a young single dad.

results.title: Ed Gein: The House of Horrors
results.original_title: Ed Gein: The House of Horrors
results.overview: After his domineering mother dies, reclusive farmer Ed Gein descends into madness, hearing her voice urging him to punish sinful women and turning his home into a house of horrors.

results.title: Seething Void
results.overview: An internet troll takes the culture’s nihilistic and ironic worldview to an extreme.

results.title: Stone Memory
results.overview: Urbanization and shifting regimes erased WWII mass graves from Serbian city centers. Brutalist architect Bogdan Bogdanović designed a monumental memorial outside Čačak, both a tribute to the victims and a testament to his architectural vision.  Now largely neglected and overgrown, the memorial is brought to life through the voices of locals, archival materials, and reenactments. The film explores how memory, history, and architecture intersect, gradually revealing the human stories behind the monument’s silence.

results.title: P A L A C E
results.original_title: P A L A C E
results.overview: New Orleans’ beloved Historic Palace Theatre is set for demolition, when the supervisor behind the project discovers why it closed down from the souls lost inside.

results.title: Throuple
results.overview: Michael, a lonely gay singer-songwriter terrified of pursuing his musical dreams and exploring romantic intimacy, relies on his best friend and her girlfriend for support and affection. However, when he meets a newly open married couple seeking a casual encounter, the three men enter into a relationship that is more vulnerable than any of them ever expected.

results.title: Falling House
results.overview: A modest family on the outskirts of Tehran faces the imminent destruction of their home as a part of a vast redevelopment project. While Rashid, the father and a prison guard, is being accused of corruption, he discovers that his eldest daughter, Ensi, is secretly planning to leave Iran to become a model. As the bulldozers draw ever closer, the tensions within the household start to rise.

results.title: The Vampires of New Orleans
results.overview: The horrors of New Orleans history reverberate down to the present in this docudrama combining Southern Gothic terror with investigations into the city's real-life folklore.

results.title: Cecil
results.overview: In 2015 a lion in Zimbabwe named Cecil was killed by Walter Palmer, an American dentist, provoking a global outcry. The story of Cecil’s death turns the gaze back on to us and our behaviour. The simplicity of the outrage is a stark contrast to the complexity of the reality.
